title: Chapter 963
text: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven. —Matthew 18:10 King James Version Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth. —Luke 15:10 King James Version For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone. —Psalm 91:11-12 King James Version
